description: Fetch a Stack Exchange question and a page of answers, accepted first then by score, with Markdown bodies and attribution. Accepts a question ID, a full question URL, or a Share URL like "https://stackoverflow.com/q/11227809" or "https://stackoverflow.com/a/11227902". Use answersPage to continue and includeComments to read corrections and follow-up discussion.

answersPage.description: Votes page to fetch, starting at 1. Keep maxAnswers fixed when paging.

commentsPage.description: Comment page to fetch with includeComments, starting at 1. Keep the question URL, answersPage and maxAnswers fixed when paging comments.

includeComments.description: Fetch the requested comments page on the question and on batches of up to 100 returned answer IDs. An out-of-page answer from a long URL can add a separate comments request.

maxAnswers.description: Votes page size (1–100, default 10). The linked answer and the first page’s accepted answer can add items beyond this size.

questionIdOrUrl.description: Numeric question ID or a Stack Exchange question or answer URL (/questions/, /q/, or /a/). A URL supplies its site. If its host is unknown to Stack Exchange, the tool uses the explicit site when provided and otherwise reports invalid_site.

site.description: Stack Exchange site a numeric question ID belongs to — the apiSiteParameter (e.g. "stackoverflow", "unix") or the site's domain (e.g. "unix.stackexchange.com"). Defaults to "stackoverflow". Not needed with a URL, which names its own site: a site naming a different one is ignored, or used when the URL host is not a Stack Exchange site, and either way reported as siteConflict. Call stackexchange_list_sites to discover valid values.

name: stackexchange_get_thread

acceptedAnswerId.description: ID of the accepted answer when one exists.

answerCount.description: Total answers the question has upstream, across all pages. Use nextAnswersPage, when present, to continue.

answers.description: Answers sorted: accepted answer first, then by score descending.

items.description: A single Q&A answer with markdown body, score, dates, and author attribution.

authorLink.description: Answer author profile URL when available.

authorName.description: Answer author display name when available.

authorUserId.description: Answer author numeric user ID when available — pass to stackexchange_get_user to fetch the full profile.

bodyMarkdown.description: Answer body normalized from HTML to markdown.

comments.description: Comments on this answer, newest first. An empty array means no entries on the requested page. An absent array means comments were not requested or no entries for this post could be established from the fetched page.

items.description: A single comment with markdown body, score, date, and author attribution.

authorLink.description: Comment author profile URL when available.

authorName.description: Comment author display name when available.

bodyMarkdown.description: Comment body normalized from HTML to markdown.

creationDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the comment was posted — the newest comments carry the freshest corrections.

score.description: Comment score — comments can score below zero.

commentsTruncated.description: True when this slice doesn't establish the answer's full comment list.

creationDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the answer was posted — an old answer may predate the current API.

isAccepted.description: True when this is the accepted answer.

lastActivityDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent edit or activity on the answer.

answersPage.description: Requested votes page when greater than 1.

authorLink.description: Question author profile URL when available.

authorName.description: Question author display name when available.

authorUserId.description: Question author numeric user ID when available — pass to stackexchange_get_user to fetch the full profile.

bodyMarkdown.description: Question body normalized from HTML to markdown.

cap.description: The maxAnswers cap applied to this request.

closedDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the question was closed.

closedReason.description: Reason Stack Exchange gives for closing the question.

comments.description: Comments on the question, newest first. An empty array means no entries on the requested page. An absent array means comments were not requested or no entries for this post could be established from the fetched page.

items.description: A single comment with markdown body, score, date, and author attribution.

authorLink.description: Comment author profile URL when available.

authorName.description: Comment author display name when available.

bodyMarkdown.description: Comment body normalized from HTML to markdown.

creationDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the comment was posted — the newest comments carry the freshest corrections.

score.description: Comment score — comments can score below zero.

commentsCap.description: Maximum number of comments per upstream page, shared across all IDs in an answer batch.

commentsPage.description: Requested comment page when greater than 1 and comments were requested.

commentsTruncated.description: True when this slice doesn't establish the question's full comment list.

creationDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the question was asked — use it to judge whether the advice is still current.

duplicateOf.description: Original questions for a duplicate, in Stack Exchange order. Pass their question IDs to this tool with the same site.

items.description: A question identified by Stack Exchange as an original of this duplicate.

answerCount.description: Answer count on the original question.

questionId.description: Original question ID on the same site.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `question_not_found`: The question lookup returns an empty result set — SE returns HTTP 200 with no items for unknown question IDs rather than 404. `answer_not_found`: An answer Share URL refers to an answer absent from the Stack Exchange response. `paging_depth_limit`: Stack Exchange refused a requested page above 25 without an API key. `invalid_site`: The site value, or the host of a question URL, is not a Stack Exchange network site. `invalid_id_or_url`: The input has no recognized question ID or post URL, or Stack Exchange refused the ID. `invalid_parameter`: Stack Exchange rejected a request parameter other than the question ID, and named the field. `quota_exceeded`: The Stack Exchange API quota_remaining has reached 0. `throttled`: Stack Exchange returned an IP throttle, or the backoff for this API method exceeds the remaining time. `pacer_shed`: The call would wait in this server's queue to Stack Exchange longer than its time budget allows. `invalid_api_key`: Stack Exchange does not recognize the API key this server is configured with. `upstream_unavailable`: Stack Exchange reported itself temporarily unavailable or failing internally, or answered with a body that is not the expected JSON envelope. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

lastActivityDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent activity on the question (edit, answer, or comment).

nextAnswerCommentsPage.description: Next commentsPage when at least one answer batch has more comments.

nextAnswersPage.description: Next answersPage when Stack Exchange reports more votes-ranked answers.

nextQuestionCommentsPage.description: Next commentsPage when the question has more comments.

notice.description: How to continue the answer page or which linked content could not be read.

questionId.description: Numeric question ID — identifies this thread on the site.

quotaMax.description: Maximum API quota calls per day (300 keyless, ~10,000 with API key).

quotaRemaining.description: Remaining API quota calls for the current day.

siteConflict.description: Present only when questionIdOrUrl is a URL and site names a different site — says which of the two the question was read from.

resolvedBy.description: Which one the question was read from: "url_host" when site was ignored in favor of the URL's own site, "site" when the URL host is not a Stack Exchange site and site was used instead.

items.description: A tag applied to this question.

truncated.description: True when the votes page has a successor.
